pages.text: Create: Northstar adds a solar system as dimensions: the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus, plus an orbit above each planet. You get there with a rocket built from Create parts, or by flying an Aeronautics ship upward.

A Northstar rocket is a contraption: thrusters, fuel tanks, a seat and controls glued around a Rocket Station. An Aeronautics ship uses a Dimensional Drive or Stellar Navigator instead. See $(l:space/rocket_building)Rockets$(/l) and $(l:space/aeronautics_bridge)Ship Bridges$(/l).
pages.title: Two ways up

pages.text: Destinations come from the $(item)Space Atlas$(). Planets unlock as you add science to it from Astronomical Readings. Landing on a planet needs an Interplanetary Navigator aboard; the Moon does not, since it is a moon.
pages.title: Before you go
Space Atlas
pages.text: Holds coordinates of bodies and saved waypoints. Put it in a Rocket Station to set the destination.
A Book and a Titanium Ingot.

pages.title: Telescope
pages.text: Hold to take an astronomical reading. Needs night and 1 Paper. It does not work in every dimension.

pages.title: Astronomy Table
pages.text: Turns readings into science for the atlas. Readings of different planets are worth more, and one planet gives one reading per day.
Titanium is the key metal here, replacing iron plates in much of the tech. See $(l:space/space_materials)Space Metals$(/l). Oxygen and suits are in $(l:space/space_survival)Oxygen and Suits$(/l).
